text: マヨ　すまねえなあ　とうちゃん　おまえが　こわがってたの　しらなくて

structure.jp: マヨ　すまねえなあ
おまえが　こわがってたの

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the whole action into a thing that can be known or talked about. おまえがこわがってたの = 'the fact that you were scared'.

patterns.name: 〜なくて
patterns.explanation: なくて means 'not doing, and so', giving the reason for the apology said earlier. しらなくて = 'because I didn't know'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てた is the short spoken form of ていた, which says something was going on. こわがってた = 'was being scared'.
